subject: Exceptional merit / equity refresh request for Rishi Malhotra
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-05T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: off-cycle merit + equity refresh for Rishi Malhotra

Hi Laura / Markus,

Quick ask — Rishi (IC4, Search Relevance) joined mid-cycle in Q4 and was not eligible for the annual merit window. Over the last 6 months he has led two major infra optimizations that improved inference cost per token and contributed to a pilot that landed a strategic customer. With calibration completed, my manager recommendation is an off-cycle merit increase of 12% (base) plus a small equity refresh (10% target refresh, consolidated grants). This is outside the standard 6–8% guideline and requires exception approval.

I've attached a short performance summary and the comp worksheet with projected run-rate. Key points:
- Strong impact: cross-functional delivery, measurable cost savings.
- Retention risk: multiple inbound recruiter contacts in last quarter.
- Peer calibration: rated exceed on calibration matrix.

Can we get sign-off from People + your OK, Laura? If approved, we'll route to Payroll / CompOps for processing with effective date 2026-04-01.

Attachments: performance_summary_rishi.pdf, rishi_comp_worksheet.xlsx

Thanks,
Priyom
Priyom Das
Manager, Relevance Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-05T11:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: off-cycle merit + equity refresh for Rishi Malhotra

Thanks for the write-up, Priyom — this is clear and the performance notes help. A few items we need before People can sign the exception: 

1) Calibration score + peer comparators (can be a one-paragraph summary).
2) Baseline comp and proposed new base + on-target run-rate (you included a worksheet but please call out run-rate in the body).
3) Confirmation of budget owner (who will own the recurring run-rate).
4) Manager attestation to retention/market factors and whether alternative retention levers (bonus or accelerated vesting) were considered.

Per policy, the typical merit window is 6–8%; exceptions >10% need VP + People Director sign-off and Finance acceptance. Once we have the items above I can draft the exception form and queue it for signature.

Also, we'll need the attached approval_form_LB_signed.pdf (executive approval) before routing to Workday.

Monica Patel
Senior People Partner, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-05T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: off-cycle merit + equity refresh for Rishi Malhotra

I reviewed Priyom's request and the attached summary. I'm supportive of an exception in principle given the business impact. A couple notes:

- Recommend capping merit at 10% (vs 12%) to balance comp governance; equity refresh at the proposed 10% looks reasonable.
- Need a simple run-rate summary for Finance (annualized comp delta + one-time equity cost).

Priyom, please update the worksheet and include the budget owner (myself as the budget owner for now). Monica, if you confirm People Director sign-off, Laura — please confirm final approval and sign the attached executive form so we can pass to CompOps.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
VP, Product & Search
Redwood Inference
